note: Marina campground on Guist Creek Lake, Shelbyville's water-supply lake. The nightly pull-through loop sits in the trees north of the marina; the lakeshore sites are long-term leases. Sites 101-104 and 116 are the large ones. Restaurant, boat ramp and boat rentals at the marina. Camping may be suspended in Red Flag fire weather. --Claude
summary: Kept. $45 flat confirmed (6% tax, 2-night prepay, non-refundable); own booking engine (closed for the season, reopens in March); 31 W/E 30/50A pull-throughs (3 monthly), showers, restrooms, dump. Waterfront down: lakeview -> not waterfront (nightly loop ~80+ m from the east cove through trees and long-term units). Google 4.6 (394).
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN: lakeview -> not waterfront. The operator's own aerial and imagery put the nightly pull-through loop (sites 101-131) in a wooded strip east of the entrance road, centred ~38.2114,-85.1440: its east lane is ~80-90 m from the east cove through trees and a row of long-term units, and the main lake to the west is behind the road, a field, trailer storage and the shoreline long-term sites. The waterline units are the long-term leases ('Private dock option available'). No nightly site found with an open view; the stored evidence's 'line of sight across open grass' was not borne out.

LONG-STAY SHARE: 28 of the 31 numbered RV sites are sold by the night (105, 109, 111 monthly), plus an unpublished number of long-term seasonal sites along both shores (imagery shows roughly 30-40 shoreline units). Roughly half nightly; not 'mostly seasonal' on the evidence, and Google 4.6 from 394 reviews, so no drop.
STATUS/SEASON: site says 'Closed for the season ... Reservations will reopen in March' (read 2026-11-23); no closing or opening dates published. Stored derived season 03-01..11-30 left as is.
PIN: stored 38.21012,-85.14488 is the marina/office; the nightly loop is ~160 m NNE (~38.2114,-85.1440). Under 250 m, left.
XL sites (101-104, 116) are 'ideal for rigs over 40 ft'; no lengths published for the others.
